transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here mostly because I’m just really tired, and sleep doesn’t seem to fix it. Even small things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, can feel like too much.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly. Maybe kind of low sometimes, but mostly I just feel worn out.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Yeah… I’ve kind of stopped caring about things I normally like. I used to sketch, go to gallery openings, cook, do yoga, even play tennis with a friend sometimes. Lately I just don’t feel interested in any of it.
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous lately?
Not really nervous, no. I mean, I have normal worries here and there, but I wouldn’t say anxiety is the main thing I’m dealing with.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?
Yeah, a little. I haven’t been trying to lose weight, but my jeans feel looser. My appetite’s been off too—some days I’ll realize I’ve only had coffee and a few bites of food.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I think it’s been about four months now. It started around the time my spouse and I began arguing a lot more often.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive or of harming yourself?
No, I haven’t had thoughts like that. I’ve been stressed, but I don’t want to hurt myself or anything.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual?
Yeah, on some days I do. It’s like my body is moving through wet cement. Even answering a simple question from my spouse can take me a weirdly long time.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Not really, no. I mean, I feel bad when things are tense at home, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling guilty about anything in particular.
Have you ever felt this way before?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had rough patches before, but I don’t know if it was exactly like this.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure most of the time?

Yeah, most of the time lately. I’ve kind of stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself—sketching, going to gallery openings, cooking, yoga. Even playing tennis with a friend just doesn’t sound appealing. It’s not that I hate those things now, I just don’t really feel much from them.
Do you feel like these feelings of tiredness and lack of interest are interfering with your daily life most of the time?

Yeah, it is. I’ve fallen behind on my certificate coursework, and basic stuff like bills, meals, and chores has been piling up. I make plans to catch up, but I can’t seem to keep them organized or follow through. My spouse has had to take over more at home, and I’ve been pulling back from friends and art things I’d normally care about.
Do you feel like these feelings have been present every day, or are there some days when you feel somewhat better?
It’s been pretty much every day, honestly. Maybe some days are a little less awful than others, but the low interest and heavy tired feeling has been going on for about three months now.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt better and your interest in activities returned?

No, not really. I haven’t had a two-week stretch where I felt back to normal or interested in things again. It’s been this quieter low period for about three months now, with the low interest and that heavy fatigue pretty much sticking around.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual most of the time?
Yeah, on my slower days I really do. It feels like my body is moving through wet cement. Even answering a simple question from my spouse can take me a weirdly long time.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight, such as more than 5% of your body weight, over the past few months?

I’m not sure the exact percentage, but yeah, I’ve lost some weight without trying. My appetite’s been pretty off—some days I realize I’ve only had coffee and a few bites of food, and my jeans are definitely looser.
Would you say that these feelings of tiredness and lack of interest are interfering with your daily life almost all of the time?

Yes. It’s been getting in the way pretty much every day. I’ve fallen behind in my certificate coursework, and stuff like bills, meals, and basic house chores just piles up because I can’t stay organized or follow through. My spouse has had to take over more at home, and I’ve pulled back from friends and art things I usually care about.
Would you say that your low mood or lack of interest in activities is present for most of the day?

Yes, most of the day. It’s like I just don’t care about the things that usually make me feel like myself—sketching, gallery openings, cooking, yoga, even playing tennis with a friend. I’ll think about doing them and then just… not feel anything pulling me toward them.
Would you say that your feelings of worthlessness or guilt are present nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say nearly every day. I do get down on myself sometimes, like I’m not handling things the way I should, but I haven’t really been tracking how often that happens.
Have you been having thoughts about death or dying?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt really low and overwhelmed, but I haven’t been thinking about death or dying in any specific way.
